changelog: fix: /beta served the PRODUCTION console instead of the beta one. Starlette compiles Mount("/beta") to ^/beta/(?P<path>.*)$ — the slash is mandatory — so a bare /beta never matched the mount. Starlette would normally redirect to /beta/, but only when nothing matched at all, and the SPA catch-all matches every path there is, so it answered first. The page loaded; it was simply not the page that was asked for, which reads as 'the beta build never updates' rather than as an error. /beta and /beta/ are now explicit routes registered above the mount, and the mount is kept for files the beta console gains later. The SPA catch-all now refuses any /beta URL with a 404 naming the file it expected, instead of substituting a different application for the one requested — the same rule as 2.8.5's database resolution: never quietly serve something else. deploy_dev.sh also reports whether the beta index actually synced.
